title: XXXIV Drawings for Dante's Inferno (F. 19, S. 15)
medium: The complete set of 35 prints, including lithograph *Kar* and 34 facsimiles in colors, on Angoumois à la main and wove papers, with full margins and the full sheets, with text of Dante's *Inferno *translated by John Ciardi, all contained in the original cloth-covered portfolio.
